scope.suite: Exact task238 SWE100, mini-swe-agent 2.1, fixed original 100 tasks
scope.method: Unchanged native Harbor agent, evaluator, parser, reward, sampling and model runtime; model YAML name/location only
scope.placement: cw-rno2a, interactive requested 0/0, 49h CPU owners and owned 12h eight-H100 serves, fresh ttl=14d outputs
scope.submission: One prepare then submit pair per isolated process, or sequential pairs. Do not prepare all then submit with the last process-global MARIN_PREFIX. All 12 native output directories and record prefixes must remain disjoint.
scope.guards: Executor must verify fresh source/HF metadata guards and write probes before allocation; actual native bundles and namespace bindings must match this packet. Existing TTL model paths are not silently retargeted to permanent KEEP copies.

analysis_and_recovery.admission: Each primary run requires all 100 unique fixed task IDs with finite binary native scored rewards and provenance joins. Preserve scored agent failures; never zero-impute unscored infrastructure rows.
analysis_and_recovery.bootstrap: Frozen independent suite Python Random(297), 10000 run-level draws, shared condition draws and unadjusted intervals; no item or repeat pairing, historical SWE pooling, or partial primary decisions.
analysis_and_recovery.diagnostic: Preserve original-run all-100 native trajectories and available provider evidence. Count strict normal-stop no-tool sessions separately from format recovery, timeout, missing evidence and submit-only actions. The mini agent can reject a no-tool answer before trajectory admission, so absent text is unknown, not an invented no-call zero.
analysis_and_recovery.retry: Standard Harbor internal max10 retry behavior remains unchanged and distinct from n_attempts=1, Iris requested 0/0 and the owner-authorized one whole fresh replacement for a terminal incomplete logical run. No valid-score rerun, partial repair or best-of selection.

cost: Historical estimate approximately 203.08 H100h for 12 runs, not a cap or achieved usage; external Daytona sandbox compute, storage and network are unmeasured by this Iris estimate.
limits: Read-only source/configuration/native-constructor/ZIP fixtures passed; no live model or storage calls by reviewer. This verdict proves neither execution readiness nor coverage, diagnostic availability, capability, identity or release quality. No A9, A10, maths, KEEP or native-boundary-screen dependency; no training authority.
